# UatuCode

UatuCode is a local documentation workbench and self-hostable Hub with a public HTTP and streaming API contract.

Machine-readable contract (built from `main`):
- Metadata: https://tjakobsson.github.io/uatu/api/contract.json
- Agent guide: https://tjakobsson.github.io/uatu/api/agent.md
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://tjakobsson.github.io/uatu/api/openapi.yaml
- Streaming contract: https://tjakobsson.github.io/uatu/api/streaming.yaml
- API changelog: https://tjakobsson.github.io/uatu/api/CHANGELOG.md

Human documentation:
- Product and guides: https://tjakobsson.github.io/uatu/
- Searchable API reference: https://tjakobsson.github.io/uatu/docs/api/

OpenAPI governs HTTP wire details. The streaming contract governs SSE, NDJSON, and WebSocket behavior. Metadata and changelog govern revision selection and migration. Contract metadata reports the `sourceCommit` it was built from.
